# Sync-scroll heading fixture

`sync-scroll.md` is a committed, deterministic Markdown document for the slice 9 sync-scroll tests: 40 unique headings, each followed by two lines of body text, with a 15-line fenced code block inside `## Heading 20` so a heading also sits below a tall block. Its line numbers are fixed; do not reformat the file.
